title: Instructions for recreating elPrep 4.0.0 WGS benchmarks
author: Charlotte Herzeel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w35fgq6

steps.title: Configure working environment
steps.instruction: Create a working directory (WORKDIR) and add the elPrep binary directory to the PATH: PATH=$WORKDIR/elprep-v4.0.0:$PATH

steps.title: Install elPrep 4.0.0
steps.instruction: Download the elPrep v4.0.0 binary tarball, rename it, extract it, and make it executable.

steps.title: Install BWA 0.7.17
steps.instruction: Download, extract, compile, and install BWA version 0.7.17.

steps.title: Install FASTQ identifier tool
steps.instruction: Using a working Go installation, download and build the correct‑platinum‑fastq‑sequence‑identifier tool.

steps.title: Download required data files
steps.instruction: Obtain the Illumina Platinum NA12878 FASTQ files, the hg38 reference genome, and the known‑variant VCFs from the URLs listed in the protocol.

steps.title: Create reference index
steps.instruction: Uncompress the hg38 reference FASTA and build a BWA index; this step takes about 60 minutes.

steps.title: Correct FASTQ read identifiers
steps.instruction: Run the correct‑platinum‑fastq‑sequence‑identifier tool in parallel on each FASTQ file; each invocation requires roughly 3.5 hours.

steps.title: Align FASTQ and filter to BAM
steps.instruction: Align the corrected FASTQ files to the hg38 reference using BWA‑mem with 72 threads and a read‑group header, pipe the output to elPrep filter, and write NA12878.bam; expected runtime ~6 h 10 min.

substeps.instruction: bwa-0.7.17/bwa mem -t 72 -R '@RG\tID:Group1\tLB:lib1\tPL:illumina\tSM:sample1' GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna ERR194147OPT_1.fastq.gz ERR194147OPT_2.fastq.gz | elprep filter /dev/stdin NA12878.bam

steps.title: Convert reference to elfasta
steps.instruction: Create an elPrep‑specific ELFasta file from the hg38 reference; takes about 1 minute.

steps.title: Create elsites files from VCFs
steps.instruction: Uncompress each VCF and convert it to an elsites file using elPrep; dbSNP conversion ~1 minute, Mills conversion ~10 seconds.

steps.title: Run elPrep benchmarking pipeline
steps.instruction: Execute the full elPrep SFM pipeline with duplicate marking, BQSR, and sorting; expected runtime 3 h 37 min and requires 192 GB RAM.

substeps.instruction: elprep sfm NA12878.bam NA12878.sfm.bam --mark-duplicates --mark-optical-duplicates NA12878.sfm.metrics --sorting-order coordinate --bqsr NA12878.sfm.recal --known-sites dbsnp_138.hg38.elsites,Mills_and_1000G_gold_standard.indels.hg38.elsites --bqsr-reference hg38.elfasta
